text:
anna: quick idea — propose we rollforward the adapter-convergence patchset (v3) but do a gradual deprecation of the hosted-only hooks. want to capture the tradeoffs and a rollout plan

mike: +1 on gradual. main concern is auth surface differences between hosted and private (KMS/HSM flows). if we unify the handshake we need a way to opt-out per-tenant.

sophia: agree. also telemetry: hosted currently emits token-level metrics, private sends aggregated telemetry. we need a compatibility shim or clear contract for metrics (sampled vs exact).

raj: suggest a capability negotiation handshake at startup. runtime announces: `capabilities: [streaming, prefix_cache, kv_v2, audit_log]` and control-plane can gate features. fallback policy if capability missing: fallback to compatible model variant or deny.

kim: important: secret handling. hosted uses control-plane KMS, private expects customer-managed KMS. new adapter must expose a capability flag e.g. `kms_managed:true|false`. No default migration to hosted KMS.

anna: here's a minimal capability manifest example we can use for negotiation:
```json
{
  "capabilities": ["streaming", "kv_cache", "fallback_route"],
  "protocol_version": 3
}
```

mike: nice. keep protocol_version small and increment-only. also add `auth_modes: ["token","kms_sign"]` so control-plane knows what flows to use.

raj: ops question — how do we measure regressions during canary? propose metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, token cost per request, auth failure rate, fallback rate, and qualitative evals on a small prompt set.

sophia: add quality/regression metric: semantic drift (embedding distance on canonical prompts) and truncated token ratio (to catch unexpected early truncation).

kim: rollout command for infra team (example):
```
redwoodctl rollout --feature adapter-converge-v3 --percent 10 --canary "arch-team"
```

anna: plan: week 1 - internal canary (10%), watch metrics for 48h. week 2 - expand to dedicated customers who opt-in (50%), run full QA on private KMS flows. week 3 - widen to hosted. deprecate old hooks after 30 days of stable metrics.

mike: any DB migrations? we need a capability table: `tenant_capabilities` with schema: tenant_id, capability, version, reported_at. nonblocking but required for audit and rollout filters.

raj: logging/audit — private deployments must be able to disable token-level telemetry; we should cleanly separate audit sinks from metric sinks. config flag `audit_sink: [cloudwatch, file, kafka]`.

sophia: also add fallback policy config per-route, so product can choose `fallback: fail | model_variant | queue_for_retry`.

infra-bot: deploybot: starting canary rollout for adapter-converge-v3 -> 10% (ids: a3f9) at 2026-03-20T10:12:00Z

anna: action items:
- mike: add `auth_modes` and KMS flag to capability manifest + proto update (ETA: 2d)
- kim: draft rollout script for infra + rollback hooks (ETA: 1d)
- raj: add DB table DDL and query patterns for capability lookup (ETA: 3d)
- sophia: assemble eval prompts and dashboard widgets (ETA: 2d)

mike: i'll PR the proto changes today, will link here when ready. :thumbsup:

anna: thanks all — keeping the handshake small is key. we'll reconvene after the proto PR and infra script reviews. :rocket:
